correctness.rationale: The exact stationary Fokker--Planck and gauge transformation give psi''=Q psi. Q approaches k²>0, the defect 5Q'^2/(16Q²)-Q''/(4Q) is absolutely integrable, so the positive stationary resolvent selects a unique decaying WKB mode with nonzero finite amplitude. Direct power integration of sqrt(Q)-k proves the three respective finite/logarithmic/growing residual regimes, with correct coefficients. A fresh checker on the actual package path passed 105 finite assertions; those tests are not used as infinite proofs.

The earlier arbitrary-potential framework and generic WKB theory remain acknowledged priority risks; neither by itself states the application-specific classification.

value.rationale: The half-power threshold is the exact integrability boundary for the square of the weak confining force, not an arbitrary computational parameter. It yields physically distinct normalized rare-displacement tails: finite-amplitude, algebraic, and stretched-exponential correction at fixed resetting, absent from unreset thermal relaxation and leading gas EVS. The classification gives the first quantified subleading tail effect in the motivating smooth sublinear potential family among the sources assessed; no general WKB theorem is claimed as new.
